core_obligations: Lift the objects and the morphism to X using the Deligne system for K, a lift L' of L and the lifting lemma (proof lines 8161-8174).
Represent the lifted morphism by a morphism of bounded complexes and define K_n and L_n as the powers of an ideal times the complexes (proof lines 8176-8188).

difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes and a distinguished triangle K -> L -> M -> K[1] in D^b_Coh(O_U), the lemma asserts that there is an inverse system of distinguished triangles K_n -> L_n -> M_n -> K_n[1] in D^b_Coh(O_X) whose objects are Deligne systems and whose restriction to U is isomorphic to the given triangle (statement lines 8144-8159). The proof takes a Deligne system (K_n) for K from Lemma labelled lemma-extension-by-zero part (2), chooses L' in D^b_Coh(O_X) restricting to L, and uses Lemma labelled lemma-lift-map to find an n and a morphism K_n -> L' whose restriction to U is the given arrow K -> L, concluding that there is a morphism K' -> L' over X restricting to that arrow (proof lines 8161-8174). By Derived Categories of Schemes, Proposition labelled perfect-proposition-DCoh the proof represents this morphism by a morphism alpha^bullet : F^bullet -> G^bullet of bounded complexes of coherent O_X-modules, chooses an ideal I whose vanishing locus is X minus U, and sets K_n = I^n F^bullet and L_n = I^n G^bullet, so that alpha^bullet induces alpha_n^bullet : I^n F^bullet -> I^n G^bullet (proof lines 8176-8188). Since by the construction of cones C(alpha_n)^bullet = I^n C(alpha^bullet), one may take M_n = C(alpha_n)^bullet, giving a compatible system of distinguished triangles whose restriction to U is isomorphic to the original one by axiom TR3 and Derived Categories, Lemma labelled derived-lemma-third-isomorphism-triangle (proof lines 8190-8200). Realising the lifted triangle termwise by powers of an ideal so that the cones are again powers of the ideal is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
